instruction: Love is not a practice you do. Love itself is a state of complete union with The Divine. Faith and devotion are lower steps on the path. Love is a higher state that only the very fortunate experience. In love, the person who loves and the Divine become one. There is no feeling of 'two' or even 'one'. The thinking mind stops. This is called 'Samādhi'.
subtitle: Ramashram Satsang (Ch. Sh.)
